pub struct Local;

impl provider::Rule for Local {
    fn check(&self) -> bool {
        true
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for Local {
    fn fmt(&self, _: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub trait Own {
    fn own(&self);
}

impl Own for Local {
    fn own(&self) {}
}

impl Local {
    pub fn inherent(&self) {}
}

#[cfg(kani)]
pub struct Gated;

#[cfg(kani)]
impl Own for Gated {
    fn own(&self) {}
}
